comments.value: This is a Quest version of "Login Loop/Connection Timeout Loop"🔗https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/login-loopconnection-timeout-loop post.

details:
VRChat Version: version quest_2020.4.4p2
Oculus Quest Software Update: 
System Version 12018300093600000
[Oculus Quest 1]
Description of the bug:
Loop on "Go" screen, stuck in the middle of the world, login screen while in the loop
Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?):
When entering the VRChat Home through "Go" after the successful Login (I'm using VRChat Account), the world occasionally made me stuck in the middle of the house (near the table with pens while me facing the spawn point), then Login Screen will pop out again trying to log me in using my account. Then it will bring me to the "Go" page again (VRChat Home).
This sometimes loop indefinitely, while some other times it will load the world normally. This really pisses me off because I can't do anything else when the looping starts and I can only hope for the world to load normally everytime I hit "Go". 
THIS ALSO HAPPENS WHEN I TRY TO ENTER OTHER WORLDS. 
I tried changing avatar to the one with excellent performance when trying to enter other world but sometimes same problem occurs. 
Infinite Loop and I will go back to "Go" screen.
*I do have a very stable internet connection
I did restart the VRChat, restart the device, cleared downloaded cache, updated to the latest VRChat, updated to the latest Software Version. They did nothing. 
*the VRChat update did fixed it but soon after the bug reappeared again and again.
This problem will have like 60~90% chances of happening. When it happens I feel like I really want to uninstall this game.
Also, I can tell if the world will load successfully or not. If the "Initializing World..." go up and down (kind of a glitch) then the world will load normally, whereas if it stays static means that I will stuck in the middle of the world and login screen and go back to "Go"screen and repeat.
One solution (when trying to enter other world) that has like 40% chances is to load back into the VRChat Home and loop there until it goes back normal then go to other worlds. Well, sometimes it works sometimes it doesn't. That's my only hope.
*this is because I feel like if I can load normally into VRChat Home then it should be able to load other world normally. It's like Stability issue but I don't think it's about the internet.
Any extra files? (output logs, screenshots):
I want to screen record it but I was already at this far typing my bug report, so maybe next time. 
Pls Fix this, it's ruining my VRChat experience on Oculus Quest.
title: Loading Loop on Oculus Quest
